ORDINANCE TJULN [5 (2026

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 2-I in the area bounded by

West Monroe Street, a line 175 feet east of and parallel to South
California Avenue; the public alley south of and parallel to West
Monroe Street; then a line 213 feet east of and parallel to South
California Avenue

# to those of a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2739 W. Monroe Street, Chicago Illinois 60612
